name: discover-project-all-layers-present
description: A project-wide `discover` against a model that holds all fifteen layers, answered in the DEFAULT form. That default is `summary`, which strips every descriptor `description` and omits the three declared descriptor booleans — a layer's `optional`, a field's `required` and `immutable` — where they are `false`, so that an absent one means `false`; no other key is left out. Every element kind of every layer is still here, and every declared field with its type, its `required`/`immutable` flags where they are `true`, enum members, declared unit, reference target and object-field element-kind link, and, per nested collection, its kind, its member element kinds and the strategy by which one member is identified. The prose is the one thing left out that a client cannot restore by rule, and it is in the fifteen `examples/discover-layer-<layer>-full.json` vectors, one layer at a time, because the same request at `form: "full"` is a refusal since contract `3.2.0` (`negative/discover-project-full-over-budget.json`) — an implementation is checked against the default and the fifteen, because the absence here is as load-bearing as the presence there.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` shape of a SWCraft project: fifteen scaffolded layers, `hardware/` among them, holding the processor `CPU`, the core `CORE0`, the partition `PARTITION0` and the memory `RAM0`.
context.notes: Discovery needs no approved scope: it reads nothing but registry facts and the project passport, and reads are unscoped and unaudited.

expected.notes: Full fidelity, deliberately: there is no abridgement rule in the protocol — omitting a declared default abridges nothing, because the rule restores it — and the earlier abridged pair of project-wide vectors could not be used as an acceptance input by anyone. Every top-level element kind publishes exactly the fields `schema.py` declares for it (under serialization aliases — `Connector.from_` appears as `from`), plus the one registry-declared placement field `swc.group`; every nested member kind is published beside them with `member_only` and `member_of`; and every collection publishes `member_identity`, without which a client could not construct a member address at all now that there is no ordinal step. Since contract `2.0.0` no layer is optional, so `optional` is `false` on every one of them and this summary omits it on every one (absent means `false`); `present` is still a probe of this project, and its `false` half is `discover-layer-hardware-absent.json` — an ordinary layer-narrowed discovery rather than a second copy of this document.
